newsitem.title: USA: Fourth man charged in U.S. Army training scandal.
newsitem.headline: Fourth man charged in U.S. Army training scandal.

text.p: An instructor at the Army's Aberdeen Proving Ground has been charged with five counts of sexual misconduct, bringing to four the number of trainers charged in a sex harassment probe at the base, the Army said on Wednesday.

Sgt. 1st Class Theron Brown, an instructor at the base, was charged with two counts of failure to obey an order, one count of sodomy and two counts of adultery, base spokeswoman Pat McClung said. The charges related to sexual misconduct involving two female students and one female civilian at the base, McClung said.

Three career soldiers were charged earlier with sexual misconduct including sexual harassment and, in one case, rape, involving women in their command. They face court martial trials beginning next month.
